translation:
Application for On-Campus Scholarships, Spring 2027

We announce the following regarding applications for on-campus scholarships for Spring 2027 (2027학년도 1학기). Students (undergraduate and graduate) who wish to receive an on-campus scholarship should apply on my SNU, have the application documents stamped with their academic advisor's seal (날인), and submit them to the department office within the deadline.

A. Eligible applicants: undergraduate and graduate students registered for Spring 2027 who wish to receive an on-campus scholarship for Spring 2027, international students, and students who have newly become eligible for the national merit (국가유공) or North Korean defector (북한이탈) scholarships.

B. Application period: Monday 23 November 2026 to Friday 11 December 2026, 18:00.
※ Students who do not apply cannot receive on-campus or Development Foundation (발전재단) scholarships, so you must apply. (Additional applications are not accepted.)

C. How to apply: Complete the application form on my SNU (마이스누), obtain your academic advisor's seal, and submit it to the department office.
** New graduate students cannot apply on my SNU; complete the attached application form and submit it to the department office.

D. Requests for cooperation
1) Customised scholarship for international students (유학생 맞춤형장학금): submit income proof documents as a PDF to the department office by Friday 15 January 2027.
2) Apply for the student financial aid income bracket calculation (학자금지원구간 산정), which is used to select scholarship recipients.
- This includes students not eligible for the national scholarship, such as students returning from leave or military service and recipients of other scholarships.
- Undergraduates: through a Korea Student Aid Foundation (한국장학재단) application for the national scholarship (국가장학금), national work-study (국가근로) or a student loan (학자금 대출).
※ For an undergraduate recommendation letter for insufficient grades (성적미달 추천서), the grade point average of the previous semester must be at least 1.7.
- Graduate students: the income bracket can be calculated by applying for a student loan.
※ A new scholarship for low-income graduate students is planned from Spring 2027 ('27-1학기), so you must apply for the income bracket calculation. (The income bracket calculation takes about 8 weeks, so apply in advance; applying in early January for the spring semester and in early July for the fall semester is recommended.)
